paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale with a value range from 0 to approximately 40, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity (log) Std" and also utilizes a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to just above 1.75, with numeric tick labels positioned at regular intervals of 0.25. Light gray dashed grid lines corresponding to the major ticks are present across the plot area. The data is represented by a single solid, pale orange line with diamond-shaped markers. The line begins at a peak value of approximately 1.81 at Layer 0, followed by a sharp and immediate decline to roughly 0.35 at Layer 1. After this initial drop, the line exhibits a more gradual, slightly fluctuating downward trend, passing through roughly 0.18 at Layer 4 and reaching approximately 0.03 at Layer 17. From Layer 17 onward, the line remains steady and nearly flat, maintaining a value very close to 0.00 until it ends at Layer 38.
